_comment: Managed settings: the highest precedence tier. Lives outside the auth volume
and outside the workspace, so neither a mounted repo nor the agent can reach it.
DELIBERATELY NOT SET, do not copy these in from Anthropic's worked example:
which is the whole point of having built the sandbox.
allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly - would make a repo's own .claude/settings.json
stop having any effect, defeating per-project configuration.
Both ship in profiles/untrusted.json instead, applied by --offline.
NOTE: deny rules do NOT apply under --dangerously-skip-permissions. Anything
that must hold in both modes lives in the PreToolUse hook below, which fires
from the tool execution path independently of the permission engine.
